children: Quantinuum signed two related agreements with the U.S. Department of Commerce to support its trapped-ion quantum computing roadmap. An Other Transaction Agreement under the CHIPS Act provides up to $100 million, including $56 million at signing and additional milestone-based tranches of $32 million and $12 million. A separate Securities Issuance Agreement delivered 2,369,528 Class A shares to Commerce with registration rights, transfer restrictions, and a conditional $1 repurchase right if the award is terminated for convenience before full funding. The award emphasizes U.S. control and production of resulting IP and data, with potential clawbacks for non-compliance and a performance period of up to five years.
